newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 closes up 12.7 pts at record high.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 closes up 12.7 pts at record high.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index set another record close on Friday, its ninth of the past 11 sessions, as the market extended its record-breaking post-election surge.

Boosted from the outset by an overnight Dow record, and with selected shares squeezed sharply higher by a shortage of stock in the market, the blue chip index ended 12.7 points higher at 4,693.9, above its record 4,691.1 set on May 13.

Analysts and dealers said the market continued to be underpinned by hopes for steady growth and low inflation through the rest of the year, but were reluctant to forcast further sharp gains in a market already up 14 percent this year.
